evidence.section: Agent Mode > Requirements and Cloud Connected prerequisites
evidence.statement: The 2.3.6 Agent Mode guide names Platform 10.1.x+, supported AWS feature regions, enabled Model Runtime and the CMP certificate prerequisite. Model Runtime separates Dublin Global and Frankfurt Data zone. Cloud Connected installation and SAIA-9918 exclude 2.2.0–2.3.6, offer 2.1.1 without Agent Mode and describe 2.4.0 as planned. Base-assistant regions and limited IL2 do not establish Agent Mode.
